verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Rev AI serves an llms.txt at docs.rev.ai with a markdown table of contents, and its docs pages are available as raw markdown (e.g. get-started.md, features.md), so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-readable docs. The probe shows only the start of the file, and the root /.md path returned 404. missing for 10: evidence of full llms.txt coverage or an llms-full.txt variant, independent user corroboration of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.rev.ai/llms.txt # Rev AI Developer Documentation
